sloka: नरैरिवोल्काभिरपोह्यमानो ।महागजोऽध्वानमनुप्रविष्टः ।भूयः प्रजज्वाल विलापमेवम् ।निशम्य रामः करुणम् जनन्या ॥२-२१-५३॥
transliteration: narairivolkābhirapohyamāno ।mahāgajo'dhvānamanupraviṣṭaḥ ।bhūyaḥ prajajvāla vilāpamevam ।niśamya rāmaḥ karuṇam jananyā ॥2-21-53॥

translations.english: At the (inconsolable) lamentations of his mother, Rama was in flames (within) like a mighty elephant prevented from entering the highway by men with fireworks.
